1	#!/usr/bin/env bash
2	# M4: the dashboard session against KiroCrew's REAL 0.6.0 frontend (R19).
3	#
4	#   scripts/test-session.sh [--build]
5	#
6	# The app reaches testing/harness/fake_gateway.py -- which serves the installed
7	# KiroCrew bundle, pinned, and emulates the server's auth contract -- through
8	# the offline harness's stub proxy, as in L1. Needs no Tailscale account and
9	# no real gateway, and mints nothing real: the fake's credentials are its own.
10	#
11	#   1. preflight   refuse a real tailnet name in the test config (R10)
12	#   2. gateway     the bundle pin/smoke test, then the fake's host-side
13	#                  contract self-test (make gateway-check)
14	#   3. harness     the stub proxy and the fake gateway, up
15	#   4. simulator   boot it, trust the test CA
16	#   5. tests       SessionTests (Testing configuration, R15); every test in
17	#                  the file must pass
18	#   6. teardown    whatever happened
19	#
20	# --build runs build-for-testing first.
21	set -euo pipefail
22	
23	ROOT="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")/.." && pwd)"
24	APP="$ROOT/app"
25	HARNESS="$ROOT/testing/harness"
26	SIM_NAME="${SIM_NAME:-iPhone 17}"
27	BUILD=0
28	[[ "${1:-}" == "--build" ]] && BUILD=1
29	
30	LOG_DIR="$APP/build/session-logs/$(date +%Y%m%d-%H%M%S)"
31	mkdir -p "$LOG_DIR"
32	START=$(date +%s)
33	say() { printf '::: %s\n' "$*"; }
34	
35	# ---------------------------------------------------------------- preflight --
36	say "preflight"
37	# R10: only the fixture tailnets may be named (allow-list, not deny-list).
38	"$ROOT/scripts/check-fixture-tailnets.sh" \
39	    "$APP/UITests/SessionTests.swift" "$HARNESS/fake_gateway.py" \
40	    "$HARNESS/gateway_check.py" "$HARNESS/Makefile" "$HARNESS/leaf.cnf"
41	EXPECTED=$(grep -cE '^\s*func test[A-Za-z0-9_]*\(' "$APP/UITests/SessionTests.swift")
42	
43	# ------------------------------------------------------------------ gateway --
44	teardown() {
45	    make -C "$HARNESS" --no-print-directory gateway-down >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
46	    make -C "$HARNESS" --no-print-directory harness-down >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
47	}
48	trap teardown EXIT
49	say "bundle pin and smoke test (R19)"
50	python3 "$HARNESS/fake_gateway.py" --check-bundle | sed 's/^/    /'
51	say "fake gateway contract self-test"
52	make -C "$HARNESS" --no-print-directory gateway-check > "$LOG_DIR/gateway-check.log" 2>&1 \
53	    || { cat "$LOG_DIR/gateway-check.log" >&2; echo "error: the fake gateway's self-test failed" >&2; exit 1; }
54	tail -1 "$LOG_DIR/gateway-check.log" | sed 's/^/    /'
55	
56	say "harness up"
57	make -C "$HARNESS" --no-print-directory harness-up
58	make -C "$HARNESS" --no-print-directory gateway-up
59	
60	# ---------------------------------------------------------------- simulator --
61	say "simulator: $SIM_NAME"
62	UDID=$(xcrun simctl list devices available -j | python3 -c "
63	import json, sys
64	for devs in json.load(sys.stdin)['devices'].values():
65	    for d in devs:
66	        if d['name'] == '$SIM_NAME':
67	            print(d['udid']); sys.exit(0)
68	sys.exit(1)") || { echo "error: no simulator named $SIM_NAME" >&2; exit 1; }
69	xcrun simctl bootstatus "$UDID" -b >/dev/null
70	xcrun simctl keychain "$UDID" add-root-cert "$HARNESS/ca.der"
71	# A fresh app container, so the R1 scan below reads only this run's data.
72	xcrun simctl uninstall "$UDID" net.lixom.latchkey >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
73	
74	# -------------------------------------------------------------------- build --
75	SANDBOX_FLAGS=()
76	if ! sandbox-exec -p '(version 1)(allow default)' /usr/bin/true >/dev/null 2>&1; then
77	    SANDBOX_FLAGS=("OTHER_SWIFT_FLAGS=\$(inherited) -disable-sandbox")
78	fi
79	if [[ $BUILD -eq 1 ]]; then
80	    # A vendored Go change is only in the app once the framework is rebuilt
81	    # (R29 shipped a stale one); a no-op when it is current.
82	    say "TailscaleKit framework (rebuilds only if libtailscale changed; minutes if so)"
83	    make -C "$APP" --no-print-directory framework > "$LOG_DIR/framework.log" 2>&1 \
84	        || { echo "error: TailscaleKit framework build failed; see $LOG_DIR/framework.log" >&2; exit 1; }
85	    say "build-for-testing (Testing configuration)"
86	    (cd "$APP" && xcodebuild build-for-testing -project Latchkey.xcodeproj -scheme Latchkey \
87	        -configuration Testing -destination "platform=iOS Simulator,id=$UDID" \
88	        -derivedDataPath build/DerivedData "${SANDBOX_FLAGS[@]}" > "$LOG_DIR/build.log" 2>&1) \
89	        || { echo "error: build failed; see $LOG_DIR/build.log" >&2; exit 1; }
90	fi
91	
92	# -------------------------------------------------------------------- tests --
93	say "SessionTests"
94	set +e
95	(cd "$APP" && xcodebuild test-without-building -project Latchkey.xcodeproj -scheme Latchkey \
96	    -configuration Testing -destination "platform=iOS Simulator,id=$UDID" \
97	    -derivedDataPath build/DerivedData -resultBundlePath "$LOG_DIR/tests.xcresult" \
98	    -parallel-testing-enabled NO -test-timeouts-enabled YES \
99	    -default-test-execution-time-allowance 240 \
100	    -only-testing:LatchkeyUITests/SessionTests) > "$LOG_DIR/test.log" 2>&1
101	TEST_RC=$?
102	set -e
103	grep -E "Test Case .*(passed|failed)" "$LOG_DIR/test.log" | sed 's/^/    /' || true
104	PASSED=$(grep -cE "Test Case .*SessionTests.* passed" "$LOG_DIR/test.log" || true)
105	if [[ $TEST_RC -eq 0 && "$PASSED" -ne "$EXPECTED" ]]; then
106	    echo "error: $PASSED of $EXPECTED SessionTests passed (a stale build? try --build)" >&2
107	    TEST_RC=1
108	fi
109	
110	# ----------------------------------------------------------------- R1 check --
111	# The tests redeem sign-in links (the fake's are `fk1.…`) through the real
112	# SPA. A link is a credential for 300 s: nothing the app writes may hold one.
113	# (The session and refresh COOKIES are on disk by design -- that is the
114	# session.) Validated: the app must have logged at least one redemption, or
115	# the scan proved nothing.
116	say "R1: no sign-in link in the app container or its log"
117	LEAK_RC=0
118	CONTAINER=$(xcrun simctl get_app_container "$UDID" net.lixom.latchkey data 2>/dev/null || true)
119	xcrun simctl spawn "$UDID" log show --last "$(( $(date +%s) - START + 30 ))s" \
120	    --predicate 'subsystem == "net.lixom.latchkey"' --style compact > "$LOG_DIR/unified.log" 2>/dev/null || true
121	# grep exits 0 on a match, 1 on none and 2 on an error -- and `if grep ...;
122	# then leak; else ok` read 1 and 2 alike as ok, so an unreadable file or a
123	# missing directory printed "ok" over a real hit (review, 2026-09-23: grep
124	# returns 2 even when it also matched). scan keeps the three apart: matches
125	# go to the named file, errors are shown, and the status is grep's own.
126	scan() {  # outfile, grep args...
127	    local out=$1 rc=0; shift
128	    grep "$@" > "$out" 2> "$out.err" || rc=$?
129	    if [[ $rc -ge 2 ]]; then
130	        echo "error: the scan could not read everything it was asked to (grep exit $rc):" >&2
131	        sed 's/^/    /' "$out.err" | head -5 >&2
132	    fi
133	    return $rc
134	}
135	if [[ -z "$CONTAINER" ]]; then
136	    echo "error: app container not found" >&2; LEAK_RC=1
137	else
138	    SCAN_RC=0
139	    scan "$LOG_DIR/link-leaks.txt" -rla "fk1\." "$CONTAINER/Library" "$CONTAINER/tmp" || SCAN_RC=$?
140	    if [[ -s "$LOG_DIR/link-leaks.txt" ]]; then
141	        echo "error: a sign-in link was written to disk:" >&2
142	        sed "s|$CONTAINER/|    |" "$LOG_DIR/link-leaks.txt" >&2
143	        LEAK_RC=1
144	    fi
145	    if [[ $SCAN_RC -ge 2 ]]; then
146	        echo "error: the disk scan is incomplete, so 'no link on disk' is not established" >&2
147	        LEAK_RC=1
148	    elif [[ $SCAN_RC -eq 1 ]]; then
149	        # Not vacuous only if there is web data to search. SessionTests
150	        # launch with -UITestKeepWebData, so every test's data store is
151	        # still here, not only the last one's.
152	        WK_FILES=$(find "$CONTAINER/Library/WebKit" -type f 2>/dev/null | wc -l | tr -d ' ')
153	        if [[ "$WK_FILES" -eq 0 ]]; then
154	            echo "error: no WebKit data in the container, so the disk scan searched nothing" >&2
155	            LEAK_RC=1
156	        else
157	            echo "    ok (disk: all of Library + tmp, $WK_FILES WebKit files among them)"
158	        fi
159	    fi
160	    SCAN_RC=0
161	    scan "$LOG_DIR/link-in-os-log.txt" -e "fk1\." -e "token=" "$LOG_DIR/unified.log" || SCAN_RC=$?
162	    if [[ -s "$LOG_DIR/link-in-os-log.txt" ]]; then
163	        echo "error: a sign-in link reached the unified log:" >&2
164	        head -5 "$LOG_DIR/link-in-os-log.txt" | sed 's/^/    /' >&2
165	        LEAK_RC=1
166	    fi
167	    if [[ $SCAN_RC -ge 2 ]]; then
168	        echo "error: the unified-log scan is incomplete" >&2
169	        LEAK_RC=1
170	    elif [[ $SCAN_RC -eq 1 ]]; then
171	        echo "    ok (unified log: $(wc -l < "$LOG_DIR/unified.log" | tr -d ' ') lines)"
172	    fi
173	    N=$(grep -c "Session: redeeming a token" "$LOG_DIR/unified.log" || true)
174	    if [[ "$N" -lt 1 ]]; then
175	        echo "error: no redemption was logged, so the scan proved nothing" >&2
176	        LEAK_RC=1
177	    else
178	        echo "    ok (validated: $N redemptions passed through the app)"
179	    fi
180	fi
181	[[ $LEAK_RC -eq 0 ]] || TEST_RC=1
182	
183	# ------------------------------------------------------------------ summary --
184	ELAPSED=$(( $(date +%s) - START ))
185	curl -s http://127.0.0.1:8481/__state > "$LOG_DIR/gateway-state.json" 2>/dev/null || true
186	if [[ $TEST_RC -ne 0 ]]; then
187	    xcrun simctl io "$UDID" screenshot "$LOG_DIR/failure.png" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
188	    cp "$HARNESS/.run/"*.log "$LOG_DIR/" 2>/dev/null || true
189	    say "FAILED in ${ELAPSED}s — logs, screenshot and xcresult in $LOG_DIR"
190	    exit 1
191	fi
192	say "passed in ${ELAPSED}s"

5	//  SessionTests.swift
6	//  LatchkeyUITests
7	//
8	//  M4: the dashboard session, against KiroCrew's REAL 0.6.0 frontend (R19).
9	//
10	//  The page is the installed KiroCrew bundle, served byte for byte by
11	//  testing/harness/fake_gateway.py, which emulates the server's auth
12	//  contract (redemption, 403 + X-Auth-Required, rotation with a grace window,
13	//  chain revocation, the `boot` claim, the rate limit). Its refresh
14	//  scheduler, 403 interceptor, `mc-auth-*` events and banner are the real
15	//  ones. The app reaches it the L1 way: `-TestStatusFixture` with a `gw` peer
16	//  and the stub SOCKS5 proxy, which maps gw.tail-scale.ts.net to the fake.

// Host tests for F3's pure parts: ShareItem, ShareInboxPolicy, ShareURL,
// ShareMessage and ShareOutcome (F3 §7, host rows).
import Foundation

var failures = 0
var checks = 0
func expect(_ cond: Bool, _ what: String) {
    checks += 1
    if !cond { failures += 1; print("  FAIL \(what)") }
}

let now = Date(timeIntervalSinceReferenceDate: 800_000_000)
let MB: Int64 = 1024 * 1024

func item(_ kind: ShareItem.Kind, url: String? = nil, title: String? = nil, text: String? = nil,
          note: String? = nil, filename: String? = nil) -> ShareItem {
    ShareItem(id: "i1", kind: kind, url: url, title: title, text: text, note: note, filename: filename,
              byteCount: 1, createdAt: now, source: .urlScheme)
}

print("== ShareMessage")
expect(ShareMessage.compose(item(.link, url: "https://example.com/a", title: "A title", note: "read this"))
       == "A title\nhttps://example.com/a\n\nread this",
       "link: title, URL, blank line, note")
expect(ShareMessage.compose(item(.link, url: "https://example.com/a", title: "A title"))
       == "A title\nhttps://example.com/a", "link with no note: no blank line, nothing trailing")
expect(ShareMessage.compose(item(.link, url: "https://example.com/a")) == "https://example.com/a",
       "link with no title: the URL alone")
expect(ShareMessage.compose(item(.link, url: "https://example.com/a", title: "T", note: "   \n "))
       == "T\nhttps://example.com/a", "a whitespace-only note is no note")
expect(ShareMessage.compose(item(.text, text: "some words", note: "why"))
       == "some words\n\nwhy", "text: the text, blank line, note")
expect(ShareMessage.compose(item(.text, text: "line one  \nline two\t", note: nil))
       == "line one\nline two", "no trailing whitespace on any line")
let doc = item(.document, note: "summarise", filename: "report.pdf")
let docMessage = ShareMessage.compose(doc, uploadedPath: "/srv/up/abc/report.pdf")
expect(docMessage.contains("[attached_file 1] /srv/up/abc/report.pdf"),
       "document: the gateway's token grammar with the path exactly as returned: \(docMessage)")
expect(docMessage == "summarise\n\n[attached_file 1] /srv/up/abc/report.pdf",
       "document: the note, blank line, then the token (the composer's order): \(docMessage)")
expect(ShareMessage.compose(item(.document, filename: "r.pdf"), uploadedPath: "/p/r.pdf")
       == "[attached_file 1] /p/r.pdf", "document with no note: the token alone")
expect(!docMessage.hasSuffix("\n") && !docMessage.hasSuffix(" "), "no trailing whitespace")

print("== ShareOutcome")
typealias R = ShareOutcome.Response
expect(ShareOutcome.post(R(status: 200, body: #"{"ok":true,"slot":"obsidian","mid":"m1"}"#), slot: "obsidian")
       == .sent(slot: "obsidian"), "{ok, slot} is sent")
expect(ShareOutcome.post(R(status: 200, body: #"{"ok":true,"queued":true,"queue_id":"q1"}"#), slot: "obsidian")
       == .queued(slot: "obsidian"), "{ok, queued} is QUEUED, not sent")
expect(ShareOutcome.post(R(status: 200, body: #"{"ok":true,"queued":true}"#), slot: "b").label == "queued:b",
       "and its label says so")
expect(ShareOutcome.post(R(status: 403, body: #"{"error":"Token required","code":"forbidden"}"#, authRequired: true),
                         slot: "a") == .signedOut, "403 + X-Auth-Required is signed out")
expect(ShareOutcome.post(R(status: 403, body: "CSRF check failed: request origin not allowed."), slot: "a")
       == .refused(status: 403, text: nil), "a bare 403 is a refusal")
expect(ShareOutcome.post(R(status: 403, body: "CSRF check failed"), slot: "a").label == "failed:refused-403",
       "labelled refused-403")
expect(ShareOutcome.offersPrefill(.refused(status: 403, text: nil), kind: .link), "a bare 403 offers prefill for a link")
expect(!ShareOutcome.offersPrefill(.refused(status: 403, text: nil), kind: .document), "never for a document")
expect(!ShareOutcome.offersPrefill(.unreachable, kind: .link), "not for other failures")
expect(ShareOutcome.post(R(status: nil), slot: "a") == .unreachable, "no answer is unreachable")
expect(ShareOutcome.post(R(status: 0), slot: "a").label == "failed:unreachable", "status 0 is unreachable too")
expect(ShareOutcome.post(R(status: 200, body: "<html>"), slot: "a") == .refused(status: 200, text: nil),
       "a 2xx that is not the receipt is not sent")
expect(ShareOutcome.post(R(status: 200, body: #"{"ok":false,"error":"nope"}"#), slot: "a")
       == .refused(status: 200, text: "nope"), "ok:false is not sent")
expect(ShareOutcome.post(R(status: 409, body: #"{"error":"Slot is reserved"}"#), slot: "a").label
       == "failed:Slot is reserved", "a 409 keeps the gateway's words")
switch ShareOutcome.upload(R(status: 200, body: #"{"paths":["/srv/up/x.pdf"]}"#)) {
case .success(let p): expect(p == "/srv/up/x.pdf", "upload: the first path, as returned")
case .failure: expect(false, "upload: 200 with paths is a success")
}
switch ShareOutcome.upload(R(status: 413, body: #"{"error":"File too large (max 1MB)"}"#)) {
case .success: expect(false, "413 is not a success")
case .failure(let f): expect(f.outcome.label == "failed:File too large (max 1MB)", "413 keeps the gateway's text: \(f.outcome.label)")
}
switch ShareOutcome.upload(R(status: 400, body: #"{"error":"Unsupported file type: .bin","code":"unsupported_file_type"}"#)) {
case .success: expect(false, "400 is not a success")
case .failure(let f): expect(f.outcome.label == "failed:Unsupported file type: .bin", "400 keeps the gateway's text")
}
switch ShareOutcome.upload(R(status: 200, body: #"{"paths":[]}"#)) {
case .success: expect(false, "an empty paths list is not a success")
case .failure: expect(true, "")
}
switch ShareOutcome.upload(R(status: 0)) {
case .success: expect(false, "no answer is not a success")
case .failure(let f): expect(f.outcome == .unreachable, "upload with no answer: unreachable")
}
expect(ShareOutcome.sent(slot: "a").isDelivered && ShareOutcome.queued(slot: "a").isDelivered,
       "sent and queued are delivered")
expect(!ShareOutcome.unreachable.isDelivered && !ShareOutcome.signedOut.isDelivered
       && !ShareOutcome.refused(status: 413, text: "x").isDelivered, "nothing else is")
expect(ShareOutcome.sentence(for: .unreachable, gatewayHost: "chonk").contains("Couldn't reach chonk"),
       "unreachable names the gateway")
expect(ShareOutcome.sentence(for: .queued(slot: "a"), gatewayHost: nil).hasPrefix("Queued"),
       "queued says queued")
expect(ShareOutcome.sentence(for: .refused(status: 400, text: "Unsupported file type: .bin"), gatewayHost: nil)
       == "Unsupported file type: .bin", "a refusal is the gateway's text, verbatim")
expect(ShareOutcome.sentence(for: .sessionGone, gatewayHost: nil).contains("isn't there any more"),
       "a gone session says so")
expect(ShareOutcome.uploadInterrupted(done: 3, of: 13).sentence == "Upload failed after 3 of 13 chunks.",
       "an interrupted upload says how far")
expect(ShareOutcome.unreachable.code == ShareOutcome.unreachableCode, "a failed item keeps the code")

print("== ShareInboxPolicy")
expect(ShareInboxPolicy.admit(byteCount: 50 * MB, fileExtension: ".pdf", inboxCount: 0, inboxBytes: 0)
       == .admitted(advisory: nil), "exactly 50 MB is admitted")
expect(ShareInboxPolicy.admit(byteCount: 50 * MB + 1, fileExtension: ".pdf", inboxCount: 0, inboxBytes: 0)
       == .refused(.tooLarge(byteCount: 50 * MB + 1)), "one byte over 50 MB is refused")
expect(ShareInboxPolicy.admit(byteCount: 10, fileExtension: "", inboxCount: 19, inboxBytes: 0)
       == .admitted(advisory: nil), "a 20th item is admitted")
expect(ShareInboxPolicy.admit(byteCount: 10, fileExtension: "", inboxCount: 20, inboxBytes: 0)
       == .refused(.inboxFull(waiting: 20)), "a 21st item is refused")
expect(ShareInboxPolicy.admit(byteCount: MB, fileExtension: ".pdf", inboxCount: 3, inboxBytes: 199 * MB)
       == .admitted(advisory: nil), "up to 200 MB in the inbox")
expect(ShareInboxPolicy.admit(byteCount: MB + 1, fileExtension: ".pdf", inboxCount: 3, inboxBytes: 199 * MB)
       == .refused(.inboxFull(waiting: 3)), "into the 201st MB is refused")
if case .admitted(let advisory?) = ShareInboxPolicy.admit(byteCount: 10, fileExtension: ".bin", inboxCount: 0, inboxBytes: 0) {
    expect(advisory.contains(".bin"), "an advisory names the extension")
} else {
    expect(false, ".bin is admitted with an advisory, not refused")
}
expect(ShareInboxPolicy.admit(byteCount: 10, fileExtension: ".PDF", inboxCount: 0, inboxBytes: 0)
       == .admitted(advisory: nil), "extensions compare case-insensitively")
expect(ShareInboxPolicy.sentence(for: .tooLarge(byteCount: 1)).contains("50 MB"), "too large names the limit")
expect(ShareInboxPolicy.sentence(for: .inboxFull(waiting: 20)).contains("20 shares waiting"), "full names the count")
let day: TimeInterval = 86400
let swept = ShareInboxPolicy.sweep(items: [("old", now.addingTimeInterval(-8 * day)),
                                           ("six", now.addingTimeInterval(-6 * day)),
                                           ("new", now)], now: now)
expect(swept == ["old"], "the sweep takes an 8-day item and keeps a 6-day one: \(swept)")
let staging = ShareInboxPolicy.sweepStaging([("crashed", now.addingTimeInterval(-11 * 60)),
                                             ("writing", now.addingTimeInterval(-60))], now: now)
expect(staging == ["crashed"], "a staging dir older than 10 minutes is swept, a live writer's is not: \(staging)")
var failed = item(.link, url: "https://e.com")
failed.state = .failed
failed.lastError = ShareOutcome.unreachableCode
failed.attempts = 4
expect(ShareInboxPolicy.retriesAutomatically(failed), "unreachable, 4 attempts: retried on the next foreground")
failed.attempts = 5
expect(!ShareInboxPolicy.retriesAutomatically(failed), "after 5 automatic attempts, only by Retry")
failed.attempts = 1
failed.lastError = "Unsupported file type: .bin"
expect(!ShareInboxPolicy.retriesAutomatically(failed), "a refusal is never retried by itself")

print("== ShareURL")
func parse(_ s: String) -> ShareItem? { ShareURL.parse(URL(string: s)!, id: "u1", now: now) }
let ok = parse("latchkey://share?url=https%3A%2F%2Fexample.com%2Fa-XYZ&title=A")
expect(ok?.kind == .link && ok?.url == "https://example.com/a-XYZ" && ok?.title == "A" && ok?.source == .urlScheme,
       "accepts an https link with a title")
expect(parse("latchkey://share?url=http://example.com/")?.kind == .link, "accepts http")
expect(parse("latchkey://share?url=javascript:alert(1)") == nil, "refuses javascript:")
expect(parse("latchkey://share?url=data:text/html,hi") == nil, "refuses data:")
expect(parse("latchkey://share?url=file:///etc/passwd") == nil, "refuses file:")
expect(parse("latchkey://share?url=ftp://example.com/x") == nil, "refuses ftp:")
expect(parse("latchkey://share?url=https://") == nil, "refuses a link with no host")
expect(parse("latchkey://share?text=hello")?.kind == .text, "text alone is a text share")
expect(parse("latchkey://share") == nil && parse("latchkey://share?title=only") == nil,
       "nothing to share: refused")
expect(parse("latchkey://other?url=https://e.com") == nil && parse("https://share?url=https://e.com") == nil,
       "only latchkey://share")
let longURL = "https://e.com/" + String(repeating: "a", count: ShareURL.maxURLBytes)
expect(parse("latchkey://share?url=\(longURL)") == nil, "a URL over 8 KB is refused")
let longTitle = String(repeating: "t", count: ShareURL.maxTitleBytes + 1)
expect(parse("latchkey://share?url=https://e.com&title=\(longTitle)") == nil, "a title over 1 KB is refused")
let okTitle = String(repeating: "t", count: ShareURL.maxTitleBytes)
expect(parse("latchkey://share?url=https://e.com&title=\(okTitle)") != nil, "a title of exactly 1 KB is taken")
let longText = String(repeating: "x", count: ShareURL.maxTextBytes + 1)
expect(parse("latchkey://share?text=\(longText)") == nil, "text over 64 KB is refused")
let steered = parse("latchkey://share?url=https://e.com&gateway=https://evil.ts.net&slot=obsidian&sid=x&autoSend=1")
let steeredJSON = String(data: (try? steered?.encoded()) ?? Data(), encoding: .utf8) ?? ""
expect(steered != nil && !steeredJSON.contains("evil") && !steeredJSON.contains("obsidian") && !steeredJSON.contains("autoSend"),
       "gateway=, slot=, sid= and autoSend= are ignored, never stored: \(steeredJSON)")

print("== ShareItem")
var full = ShareItem(id: "abc", kind: .document, url: nil, title: "T", text: nil, note: "n",
                     filename: "report.pdf", utType: "com.adobe.pdf", byteCount: 1234, createdAt: now,
                     source: .intent)
full.state = .failed
full.attempts = 2
full.lastError = "unreachable"
full.lastAttemptAt = now.addingTimeInterval(1.5)
let data = try! full.encoded()
expect(ShareItem.decode(data) == .item(full), "encode → decode is equal, dates to the sub-second")
var json = try! JSONSerialization.jsonObject(with: data) as! [String: Any]
json["somethingNew"] = ["x": 1]
expect(ShareItem.decode(try! JSONSerialization.data(withJSONObject: json)) == .item(full),
       "an unknown field is ignored")
json["version"] = 2
expect(ShareItem.decode(try! JSONSerialization.data(withJSONObject: json)) == .newerVersion(2),
       "version 2 is left alone, not misread")
var noSource = try! JSONSerialization.jsonObject(with: data) as! [String: Any]
noSource.removeValue(forKey: "source")
expect(ShareItem.decode(try! JSONSerialization.data(withJSONObject: noSource)) == .unreadable,
       "an item without its source is unreadable, not guessed")
expect(String(data: data, encoding: .utf8)!.contains("\"source\":\"intent\""), "the source is written")
expect(ShareItem.decode(Data("not json".utf8)) == .unreadable, "garbage is unreadable")
expect(ShareItem.sanitisedFilename("my report (final).pdf") == "my_report__final_.pdf", "sanitised as the gateway does")
expect(ShareItem.sanitisedFilename("../../etc/passwd") == "_.._etc_passwd", "no path survives")
expect(ShareItem.sanitisedFilename("") == "file", "an empty name becomes file")
expect(full.fileExtension == ".pdf", "the extension, with its dot")
expect(item(.document, filename: "README").fileExtension == "", "no extension")

print(failures == 0 ? "share: all \(checks) checks passed" : "share: \(failures) of \(checks) FAILED")
if failures != 0 { exit(1) }

#!/bin/bash
# Host tests for F3's pure parts: the inbox item, its policy, the share URL,
# the message and the gateway's answers (F3 §7).
set -euo pipefail

cd "$(dirname "$0")/.."
OUT=$(mktemp -d)
trap 'rm -rf "$OUT"' EXIT
cp scripts/test-share.swift "$OUT/main.swift"
# -O, as the other host tests: they catch optimizer-only bugs (AGENTS.md).
if ! xcrun swiftc -O App/Share/Inbox/ShareItem.swift App/Share/Inbox/ShareInboxPolicy.swift \
        App/Share/ShareURL.swift App/Share/ShareMessage.swift App/Share/ShareOutcome.swift \
        "$OUT/main.swift" -o "$OUT/share-tests" > "$OUT/build.log" 2>&1; then
    cat "$OUT/build.log" >&2
    echo "error: the share host tests do not compile" >&2
    exit 1
fi
"$OUT/share-tests"

import re
import sys
p = sys.argv[1]
out = []
n = 0
pat = re.compile(r"try await (lastResult\([^()]*\)|gatewayState\(\))")
lines = open(p).read().split("\n")
i = 0
while i < len(lines):
    line = lines[i]
    stripped = line.lstrip()
    if stripped.startswith("XCTAssert") and "try await" in line:
        # Gather the full statement (it may span lines until parens balance).
        stmt = [line]
        depth = line.count("(") - line.count(")")
        while depth > 0:
            i += 1
            stmt.append(lines[i])
            depth += lines[i].count("(") - lines[i].count(")")
        indent = line[:len(line) - len(stripped)]
        text = "\n".join(stmt)
        pre = []

        def lift(m):
            global n
            n += 1
            name = "awaited%d" % n
            pre.append("%slet %s = try await %s" % (indent, name, m.group(1)))
            return name
        text = pat.sub(lift, text)
        out.extend(pre)
        out.append(text)
    else:
        out.append(line)
    i += 1
open(p, "w").write("\n".join(out))
print("hoisted", n)

"""Mutation runs for ShareTests: each build applies a few mutants that touch
disjoint code paths, runs only the tests they target, and restores the files
from git. Usage: python3 mutants.py <repo> <build-name>..."""
import json
import os
import re
import subprocess
import sys

REPO = sys.argv[1]
APP = REPO + "/app"
D = "App/Share/ShareDelivery.swift"
O = "App/Share/ShareOutcome.swift"
P = "App/Share/Inbox/ShareInboxPolicy.swift"
R = "App/Browser/DashboardRootView.swift"

BUILDS = {
    "B1": {
        "mutants": [
            (O, 'if json["queued"] as? Bool == true { return .queued(slot: slot) }', '', "queued read as sent"),
            (O, 'if case .refused(403, nil) = outcome { return kind != .document }', 'if case .refused(403, nil) = outcome { return false }', "no prefill offered"),
            (P, 'static let lifetime: TimeInterval = 7 * 24 * 3600', 'static let lifetime: TimeInterval = 700 * 24 * 3600', "no sweep"),
        ],
        "tests": ["testABusySlotIsQueuedNotSent", "testARefusedPostOffersPrefill", "testTheSweepRunsAtLaunch"],
    },
    "B2": {
        "mutants": [
            (D, '        try? store.prepare()\n', '        store.removeAll()\n        try? store.prepare()\n', "a memory-only inbox (wiped at launch)"),
            (D, '                defaults.remember(origin: origin, .init(slotKey: slot, slotTitle: title, at: Date()))', '                _ = title', "share-defaults not written"),
            (D, '            resumeKey = key\n            item.state = .pending\n            try? store.update(item)\n            current = item\n            phase = .waiting("Waiting for sign-in.")',
             '            store.delete(item.id)\n            current = item\n            phase = .waiting("Waiting for sign-in.")', "the item dropped on 403"),
            (D, '            try? store.update(item)\n            current = item\n            AppDiagnostics.shared.sharesFailed += 1',
             '            store.delete(item.id)\n            current = item\n            AppDiagnostics.shared.sharesFailed += 1', "the item deleted on failure"),
        ],
        "tests": ["testAColdLaunchKeepsTheItem", "testAFreshSeedIsInTheInbox", "testTheLastSessionIsPreselected",
                  "testSignedOutMidShareThenResumed", "testUnreachableIsKeptAndRetried"],
    },
    "B3": {
        "mutants": [
            (D, '            switch await upload(item) {\n            case .success(let path): uploadedPath = path\n            case .failure(let f): return f.outcome\n            }',
             '            uploadedPath = "/srv/kirocrew/uploads/guessed/" + (item.filename ?? "file")', "posting before uploading"),
            (R, 'gatewayContent\n                            .padding(.bottom, keyboardUp ? 0 : max(0, inset - Self.bottomReclaim))',
             'gatewayContent\n                            .padding(.bottom, max(0, inset - Self.bottomReclaim) + (keyboardUp ? inset : 0))', "F13's double keyboard padding"),
        ],
        "tests": ["testADocumentIsUploadedThenReferenced", "testASharedLinkReachesTheChosenSession"],
    },
    "B4": {
        "mutants": [
            (D, '            guard let chunk, !chunk.isEmpty else { break }', '            guard let chunk, !chunk.isEmpty, chunk.count == Self.chunkBytes || index == 0 else { break }', "the last chunk dropped"),
            (D, '                } else if remembered != nil {\n                    self.selectedKey = nil',
             '                } else if let remembered {\n                    self.selectedKey = remembered.slotKey', "the remembered key preselected though gone"),
            (D, '        guard let key = selectedKey, sessions.contains(where: { $0.key == key }) else { return }', '        guard let key = selectedKey else { return }', "(with it) Send not limited to the list"),
            (D, '            guard fresh.contains(where: { $0.key == key }) else { return .sessionGone }', '            _ = fresh', "(with it) no verify"),
        ],
        "tests": ["testFiftyMegabytesGoThroughByteForByte", "testOnlyAListedSlotIsEverPosted"],
    },
    "B5": {
        "mutants": [
            (D, 'withJSONObject: ["message": message, "slot": key]', 'withJSONObject: ["message": message]', "posting without slot"),
            (O, '        if (200..<300).contains(status) { return nil }', '        if (200..<300).contains(status) { return nil }\n        if status == 413 || status == 400 { return .unreachable }', "swallowing the gateway's 413/400"),
        ],
        "tests": ["testASharedLinkReachesTheChosenSession", "testOverTheLimitIsRefusedAtCaptureAndA413IsShown",
                  "testAnUnsupportedTypeShowsTheGatewaysWords"],
    },
}


def sh(cmd, **kw):
    return subprocess.run(cmd, shell=True, text=True, capture_output=True, **kw)


def main():
    udid = json.loads(sh("xcrun simctl list devices available -j").stdout)
    udid = next(d["udid"] for ds in udid["devices"].values() for d in ds if d["name"] == "iPhone 17")
    env = dict(os.environ, KIROCREW_DIST="/Applications/KiroCrew.app/Contents/Resources/backend-dist/"
               "kirocrew-backend-arm64/lib/python3.12/site-packages/kiro_crew/static/dist")
    harness = REPO + "/testing/harness"
    sh("make -C %s --no-print-directory harness-up && make -C %s --no-print-directory gateway-up" % (harness, harness), env=env)
    try:
        for name in sys.argv[2:]:
            b = BUILDS[name]
            files = sorted({m[0] for m in b["mutants"]})
            try:
                for f, old, new, what in b["mutants"]:
                    p = os.path.join(APP, f)
                    s = open(p).read()
                    assert old in s, "%s: mutant '%s' not applicable" % (name, what)
                    open(p, "w").write(s.replace(old, new, 1))
                r = sh("cd %s && xcodebuild build-for-testing -project Latchkey.xcodeproj -scheme Latchkey "
                       "-configuration Testing -destination 'platform=iOS Simulator,id=%s' "
                       "-derivedDataPath build/DerivedData 'OTHER_SWIFT_FLAGS=$(inherited) -disable-sandbox'" % (APP, udid))
                if r.returncode != 0:
                    errs = sorted(set(re.findall(r"^/.*error:.*$", r.stdout, re.M)))[:5]
                    print("%s: BUILD FAILED\n  %s" % (name, "\n  ".join(errs)))
                    continue
                only = " ".join("-only-testing:LatchkeyUITests/ShareTests/%s" % t for t in b["tests"])
                bundle = "%s/build/mutant-%s.xcresult" % (APP, name)
                sh("rm -rf " + bundle)
                r = sh("cd %s && xcodebuild test-without-building -project Latchkey.xcodeproj -scheme Latchkey "
                       "-configuration Testing -destination 'platform=iOS Simulator,id=%s' -derivedDataPath build/DerivedData "
                       "-resultBundlePath %s -parallel-testing-enabled NO %s" % (APP, udid, bundle, only))
                print("== %s: %s" % (name, "; ".join(m[3] for m in b["mutants"])))
                for t in b["tests"]:
                    status = "FAILED (mutant caught)" if re.search(r"%s\]' failed" % t, r.stdout) else (
                        "PASSED (MUTANT SURVIVED)" if re.search(r"%s\]' passed" % t, r.stdout) else "did not run")
                    msgs = [m.split(" : ", 1)[-1][:160] for m in re.findall(r"error: -\[LatchkeyUITests\.ShareTests %s\] : .*" % t, r.stdout)]
                    print("  %-55s %s%s" % (t, status, ("\n      " + "\n      ".join(msgs[:2])) if msgs else ""))
            finally:
                sh("cd %s && git checkout -- %s" % (APP, " ".join(files)))
    finally:
        sh("make -C %s --no-print-directory gateway-down; make -C %s --no-print-directory harness-down" % (harness, harness))

Latchkey in the share sheet's app row. It captures a web link, text or
one file, writes one item to the inbox in group.net.lixom.latchkey and
says "Saved. Open Latchkey to send it." It never sends, links no
TailscaleKit, posts no notification (Q2) and does not try to open the
app.

Files come through loadFileRepresentation and are size-checked, then
copied; no document passes through memory in the 120 MB process.

The inbox now reads the group container first, then the app's own
container (ShareInbox); writes go to the first location. Admission
counts both. ShareInboxPolicy no longer references ShareOutcome, so the
extension compiles the inbox files without the delivery side.

project.pbxproj: new target, synchronized ShareExtension/ group,
App/ membership exceptions for the five shared files, Embed Foundation
Extensions phase and dependency on the app; CODE_SIGN_ENTITLEMENTS on
both targets.

     Connect** once from Xcode. This mints the App Store profiles for both
     ids, which `make tf` needs on disk because it exports without
     `-allowProvisioningUpdates`. Its preflight checks only the app's
     profile, so a missing extension profile shows up as an export error.

content.text:
F3 stage 2 is built and committed, and the tree is clean. One thing needs your attention first: **the session suite can't give a verdict on this Mac right now.** The fake gateway is pinned to KiroCrew 0.6.0. The venv moved to 0.7.0 and the desktop app updated itself to 0.7.1 tonight, so no pinned 0.6.0 copy is left, and 0.6.0 isn't on the package index. So every UI result below was run against the unpinned 0.7.0 frontend with the pin bypassed locally (not committed). They are exploratory evidence, not suite verdicts. Re-pinning the fake to 0.7.x is its own piece of work, since it means re-reading the auth code; your call.

**Commits** (kernel style from `d541039` on; nothing pushed):

| SHA | What |
|---|---|
| `d541039` | Landed the dirty tree: a test-only inbox count inside the picker, plus a `.gitignore` entry for `app/.local/` (the `gh` CLI's state). The `ShareDelivery.swift` diff was a leftover mutation-test set from the stopped run, so I discarded it. |
| `098ef5f` | The `ShareExtension` target (`net.lixom.latchkey.share`), the App Group on both targets, the capture sheet, and the inbox reading the group container first, then the app's own. |
| `7094016` | A bug fix the new test found, plus the share-sheet test itself. |
| `51bf1cb` | Docs: Q1 and Q2 recorded in §8/§9 as decided by you (Q2: no notification, additive later), the Xcode steps below in §8, five device checks, and the new target in `app/AGENTS.md`. |

Earlier today: `41d8980`, `12c0ca5`, `2e12c0a`, `85fc90d`, `084fd8c`.

**What you need to do in Xcode.** `xcodebuild` here can't register an App Group or make a provisioning profile.
1. Open `app/Latchkey.xcodeproj`. For the **Latchkey** target, then **ShareExtension**: Signing & Capabilities, team DX33PQ7J4A, automatic signing on. Make sure **App Groups → `group.net.lixom.latchkey`** is ticked (press refresh if it's red). That registers the group and the extension's App ID.
2. Run once on the phone. That makes the development profiles for both targets. `make device` fails until you do, because the current profile has no App Group.
3. Product → Archive → Distribute App → App Store Connect, once. That makes both App Store profiles, which `make tf` needs on disk because it can't create them. Its preflight only checks the app's profile, so a missing extension profile would show up as an export error. I didn't change `testflight.sh`, because I can't test it without signing.
4. On the phone, share from Safari: Latchkey should be in the app row (maybe under More the first time). Tap Save, open Latchkey, send.

The one-time "Send to Latchkey" Shortcut from stage 1 still applies (spec §4.2).

**Not additive** (small, and stated in §9):
- `ShareInboxPolicy` no longer references `ShareOutcome`, so the extension can compile the inbox files alone.
- Stage 1 had no code for reading a second location, although §4.3 said the app reads both. So the store gained a small two-location wrapper (`ShareInbox`) that `ShareDelivery` now uses.
- The spec's 8 MB in-memory limit doesn't apply: the extension only takes files via `loadFileRepresentation`, so they always arrive on disk and never pass through memory.

**The bug the stage-2 test found.** When you come back to the app from the share sheet, SwiftUI reports the app as active before iOS does, so an item the extension had saved wasn't brought up. The fix counts the scene-phase change as active:

```diff
--- a/app/App/Share/ShareDelivery.swift
+++ b/app/App/Share/ShareDelivery.swift
@@
-        UIApplication.shared.applicationState == .active
+        sceneActive || UIApplication.shared.applicationState == .active
```

**Tests and how each was shown to fail**
- **Host** (`make test-policy`): all green. The share checks are now 91, up from 79, plus 23 page-script checks. Three new mutants were all caught: the app's own container listed before the group's, the 20-item cap counting only one location, and `item.json` written straight into place. The last one crashes the test process at the next write rather than failing its own check; that is still a catch, but I'm telling you which.
- **Stage-2 share-sheet test** (Safari → Share → Latchkey → Save → back to the app): it passes, and the item shows as coming from the extension and is sent. It failed before the fix at "the app brings the saved share up". Building without the extension embedded fails it at "Latchkey is in the share sheet's app row". It is not as fragile as the spec feared: on iOS 26, Share sits in Safari's page menu, and after that the test ran reliably. It does depend on Apple's share-sheet layout.
- **ShareTests:** 15/15 pass, exploratory as above.

**Left undone**
- Stage 1's UI mutation runs are only partly done. The first set was caught: queued read as sent, no prefill offered, and no sweep. The other four sets were interrupted and never ran.
- Nothing here has run on a device.

The KiroCrew MCP servers (@kirocrew-computer, -core, -cron, -work) weren't available in this session; nothing needed them.
